privacy.ai_training_note: Tier-dependent and this is a notable contradiction with homepage marketing. The homepage footer badge reads 'SOC 2 TYPE II · SSO/SAML · NO DATA REUSE' and an on-page claim states 'We never use your training data or images to improve other models.' However, the privacy policy states for self-serve users: 'we may use your content and anonymized insights to improve our Services and AI - never sold, never shared with other customers.' Only Enterprise customers get a contractual no-training guarantee: 'we will not use your content, prompts, Generated Assets, or custom models to train, fine-tune, evaluate, benchmark, or improve any Scenario or third-party model without your prior written consent,' backed by a signed MSA and DPA. Self-serve (Starter/Pro/Max) users do not have this contractual guarantee despite the blanket 'NO DATA REUSE' badge shown site-wide.
privacy.data_region: Servers located in the United States, hosted on AWS in US regions.

security.name: Encryption
security.value: Trust center controls list 'File systems encryption,' 'Data in transit encryption,' and 'File store encryption' under the Data control category.

security.name: SSO/SAML
security.value: SSO/SAML support advertised as an Enterprise-tier feature on the homepage and Enterprise page.

security.name: Cloud infrastructure hardening
security.value: Trust center lists 'Host hardening,' 'Infrastructure as code,' and 'Firewalls' under the Cloud Security control category (80 controls total tracked on the Bastion-powered trust portal).

security.name: Subprocessors
security.value: 21 subprocessors disclosed on the trust center; the privacy policy points to the same page for the current subprocessor and model-provider list.

security.name: Access controls / audit logging
security.value: Enterprise tier advertises 'audit logging,' advanced permissions, and role-based access control; trust center lists 'Production Deployment Access,' 'Control selection,' and 'Change Management Workflow' under Business Operations.

security.name: Data retention
security.value: Account data retained for the duration of the account plus 90 days after closure; usage data retained in identifiable form up to 24 months; generated assets deleted within 60 days of account termination.

products.name: Starter / Pro / Max (self-serve)
products.data_scope: Content and anonymized insights may be used by Scenario to improve its Services and AI; not sold or shared with other customers, but no contractual no-training guarantee.
products.notes: Credit-based monthly plans ($10-$50/mo at published rates); no SSO/SAML or dedicated DPA called out for this tier.

products.name: Enterprise
products.category: Enterprise creative AI infrastructure with governance controls
products.data_scope: Contractual no-training guarantee for content, prompts, generated assets, and custom models, backed by a signed MSA and DPA; SSO/SAML, audit logging, advanced permissions, and access to SOC 2 report.
products.notes: Positioned as 'Creative IP Governance' with 'No cross-customer data sharing'; sold via direct sales ('Talk to Sales'), custom pricing.

products.name: API / MCP Server
products.data_scope: Same underlying platform and data-handling rules as the calling account's tier (self-serve vs Enterprise).
products.notes: API-first architecture with SDKs, webhooks, Unity plugin, and an MCP server for agent integrations.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium credit-based self-serve tiers (Starter/Pro/Max, monthly or annual) plus custom-quoted Enterprise plans.

flags: The homepage-wide badge 'NO DATA REUSE' and the claim 'We never use your training data or images to improve other models' overstate the actual policy: the privacy policy permits Scenario to use self-serve (non-Enterprise) customer content and anonymized insights to improve its Services and AI. Only Enterprise customers get a contractual no-training guarantee.

The only independently-confirmed certification is SOC 2 Type II, shown consistently on both the marketing homepage and the trust.scenario.com portal (1 compliance document on file). No ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS, ISO 42001, CSA STAR, or FedRAMP evidence exists on vendor-owned pages.
Scenario's cloud host (AWS) holds ISO 27001, SOC 1, and SOC 3; this is the host's certification, not Scenario's own.
GDPR is a compliance posture (data subject rights, response timelines) based on the privacy policy, not a third-party-audited certification.
